Dear Konrad Frach,
Thank you for reaching
out
to eMobility Support. My name is
Vishal
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / R6 170002136
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
yTPBGK
Problem Description
: QA13-14 Feedback Stuck ON
Troubleshooting
: We have analyzed the logs and found that the outgoing coil QA13-14 is having issues. We suspect that the feedback coil of the contactors are stuck at ON. Due to which Outlet 2 is in error state. Please plan a site visit to replace the contactors.
2 x 8EM5903-0AA00-7AA8 > Contactor DC 2P 500A 1200VDC
Please let us know if you have any further queries.
For future reference, your case number is
0405756
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vishal Dhiman

to it.
